{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float: remove commas and cast to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter: only completed orders
completed_df = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Filter: exclude QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
valid_df = completed_df[completed_df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Compute average revenue per completed order by channel
avg_revenue_email = valid_df[valid_df['channel'] == 'email']['revenue_clean'].mean()
avg_revenue_paid_search = valid_df[valid_df['channel'] == 'paid_search']['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Compute the difference
difference = avg_revenue_email - avg_revenue_paid_search

# Output the results
print(f'Average revenue (email): ${avg_revenue_email:.2f}')
print(f'Average revenue (paid_search): ${avg_revenue_paid_search:.2f}')
print(f'Difference (email - paid_search): ${difference:.2f}')"}
